testimonials.text: The method of teaching and demonstration of principles were found most interesting and the sequential nature of the modules has helped me to appreciate the following: 1. principles of rectal polyp surveillance, the principles and guidelines for rectal cancer follow-up, evidence for blood tests and imaging review together with the review of evidence for endoscopic surveillance. And 2. The aspect on the future treatments for rectal cancer, including understanding of the evidence and role of future treatments.
The clinical case discussions and integration of imaging with surgical decision-making were especially engaging.
